events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What was your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legend live on. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking it. What's your favourite Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine the impact
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. An album that still resonates today with its powerful message. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: 25 years ago today, Apple dropped the first iPod. Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was a reality. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's big screen debut. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What are your hidden gems from this double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the music world lost an icon with the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
